article.title: Franco Cozzo
article.extract: Franco Cozzo was an Italian-Australian businessman. After moving to Melbourne from Sicily in 1955, Cozzo became known for his television advertisements, in which he would speak in English, Greek, and Italian. He later produced Australia's first non-English TV show, Carosello, which was broadcast in Italian.

turns.guesser:
Sounds like a Sicilian-born businessman who emigrated to Australia, ran furniture stores, and was famous for TV ads in English, Greek and Italian. He has since died.

GUESS: Franco Cozzo
